name: EdgeOne Makers
desc: Tencent Cloud edge platform for web apps and AI agents
desc_zh: 腾讯云的边缘 Web 与智能体开发部署平台
solves: Running an agent needs servers, sandboxes and tracing you would otherwise build yourself; push code and it runs at the edge.
solves_zh: 跑智能体要自己搭服务器、沙箱和链路追踪，现在推送代码就能在边缘节点跑起来。
best_for: You have an agent prototype on a laptop and need a public URL with sandbox, memory and logs today.
best_for_zh: 你手上有个跑在笔记本上的智能体原型，今天就要一个带沙箱、记忆和日志的公网地址。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：B — https://www.producthunt.com/products/tencent-edgeone-2 (ranked #1 of the wee）。 In-window rename plus the arrival of the AI-agent capability: on 2026-06-09 EdgeOne Pages became EdgeOne Makers and gained native Agent support (runtime, sandbox, session storage, tracing). Predecessor history from the same official news page: EdgeOne Pages Beta about a year before 2026-02-06, GA on 2026-02-06. Neither EdgeOne Pages nor EdgeOne Makers is in the ledger. Paid plans (Pro/Business) went live 2026-11-09 per https://cloud.tencent.com/announce/detail/2541. Product Hunt listed the launch on 2026-06-23/24, which is the media/launch-event date, not the official product date. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：pages.edgeone.ai 是腾讯云国际站的产品，地区筛选里应归入国际，与 ima、WorkBuddy 的记法一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://pages.edgeone.ai/resources/announcement-makers-rename
